Professional groomer where I've been taking my wire-haired dachshunds for two years now. The owner is truly skilled, and stripping isn't something everyone can do. Her results are excellent; the dogs are perfect. They're also friendly and very available for appointments, which isn't a given!
Highly recommended!

Dear Salva,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We're delighted to hear you had a positive experience at our grooming center. The well-being and satisfaction of our clients, both two-legged and four-legged, are our top priority. We hope to see you again soon!

Best regards,
The Anna Simson Grooming Center team

I came to this groomer because it had been recommended to me by another owner of a medium-sized poodle in the park, who had spoken highly of the place. So I decided to give it a try, booking an appointment for 10:00-10:30.

Unfortunately, my experience was not positive. I arrived at 10:09, after having previously notified them that I was coming, but from the moment I walked in, I was met with a very unhelpful attitude and a manner that made me feel uncomfortable.

I fully understand that there may be organizational requirements and rules to follow, but I believe that the way you interact with the customer is equally important. In this case, I didn't feel welcomed or treated with the courtesy I expected.

In the end, I decided to leave my dog ​​alone because, if I personally didn't feel comfortable with the way I was treated, I didn't feel comfortable entrusting my dog ​​to them either.

I regret leaving this review, especially since I came based on a recommendation. However, I think it's right to share my experience: the grooming service may be good, but the manner and attitude towards the customer, at least in my experience, have not been the best.

I've been a customer of Anna Simson's for a year now and I've always had a great experience, both me and my French bulldog Blanco 🤍 She's always super precise, punctual, and helpful, and the prices are really fair for the service she provides. One thing I really appreciate is the attention she pays to every detail: every time Blanco comes out with a different bow based on the season or occasion, and what's more, for Christmas, Halloween, and other holidays, she even took photos with beautiful arrangements 🥹🤍 These are attentions that not everyone does and that in my opinion really make the difference, because you can see how much she cares about the animals and her work. She's truly sweet and professional, and from now on I wouldn't trust Blanco to anyone else! I absolutely recommend her 100% and I would never change her 🐶🤍

There are people you meet by chance and who, over time, become a certainty. Anna is just that for me.
Our story began 7 years ago, when Ugo, my Miniature Schnauzer, had his first stripping with her. She was a young girl, but even then she had a passion and sensitivity for animals that over the years have developed into extraordinary professionalism.
From that day on, I followed her everywhere she worked, because when you find someone you can trust with your dog with complete peace of mind, there's no reason to look elsewhere.
Today Anna finally has her own business, Anna Simson Grooming, and I'm truly happy to have witnessed the journey that brought her to this point.
After 7 years, I can say this with certainty: the first time I chose a young groomer, today I choose a great professional whom I trust implicitly.
Well done Anna, you truly deserve it. ❤️🐾
I've been taking my poodle Cesare to them for 3 years now and have always been very satisfied! The girls are truly professional and polite!

After a year at the mercy of so-called groomers who wreaked havoc on my Jack Russell's coat, I finally found a professional who understands the meaning of stripping and how to treat a wire-haired dog's coat. Competent, capable, and passionate! The shop's team is always friendly and kind. I recommend it to everyone. Turn to a professional who, like Anna, has dedicated time to courses and training.

I took Napoleon for his grooming and was truly satisfied! Anna was excellent, very professional and attentive, and she completely met all my expectations. Napoleon came out beautiful, clean, and smelling great! 🐶❤️

You can tell she puts passion and care into her work. We'll definitely be back! Highly recommended! 😊

Hi Davide,

Thank you so much for leaving us a review! We're happy to hear you had a great experience at our grooming center. We hope to see you again soon!

Best regards,
The Anna Simson Grooming Center team

Quattro and Lia, our two Airedales, are so happy to have come to you, and so are we!!!
Well done 🤗 …

I thought I wouldn't find a grooming service for my Yuki instead I thank the fantastic girls it smells like a bar of soap thank you so much very clean and thank you for your kindness. 5 stars are not enough.

Excellent place to go for our four-legged friends here in the Tiburtina area. Professional and helpful, they recently took my little Meddy back. Always impeccable and have a great approach to our furry friends.

Thanks, Anna

Thank you so much for the love, care, and professionalism you show in your work.
My Willy (Jack Russell Terrier) and I are truly happy to have met you...
Highly recommended ❤️❤️

I took my dog ​​Ugo to this grooming shop and was truly satisfied.
The haircut was performed with great care and professionalism, respecting his needs and leaving him home beautiful, clean, and well-groomed.
A special thanks also goes to all the staff: kind, helpful, and competent people who care for the animals with patience, attention, and a lot of love. You can tell they love their job and are able to put both dogs and owners at ease.

I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for quality service and a welcoming environment. We'll definitely be back!

Exceptional!!
Professional groomers, I'm very happy with the way they cut my Isotta's fur.
They're kind and friendly, and they even do ozone treatment.
My previous groomer didn't do it.
Next time I come back, I'll definitely have it done.
Thanks again ;)
I was shocked to hear they don't groom older dogs. Older dogs don't get bathed!

We've been bringing our wire-haired Jack Russells to Anna and her team for at least four years now. Stripping is a special technique, and there needs to be a great connection between the groomer and the dog. From the very first time with our first sire, Nana, we had a great time! They are very good, very professional, and extremely sweet. Well done! 👏🏻👏🏻🌸🐶🐶🐶

I'm very satisfied with the grooming of my poodle. Not everyone knows how to groom this breed well, as it requires skill and attention, but here the results were truly excellent. The staff is always punctual, helpful, and professional, attentive to the needs of both the dog and the owner. I recommend this groomer to anyone looking for quality, experience, and attention to detail.

I took my Lakeland Terrier to this specialized grooming salon and was truly satisfied. Finally, a place where they know terrier grooming well and work with great skill and attention to detail. The result was impeccable: the stripping was done perfectly, the dog was neat, happy, and not at all stressed. Anna is very kind, professional, and very helpful. You can see her passion for this work! Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality and experience in grooming!

Hi everyone! Today we took our cat Sushi to the groomer for the first time. Anna and Silvia took admirable care of him. Our cat is reluctant to be brushed or combed, yet Anna was affectionate, calm, and patient, and he let all the treatments be done, something he's never done with us! The result was amazing! If you have a four-legged friend, I highly recommend her: Anna knows her job very well! We'll definitely be back! Stefania

I would travel to Rome again just to have my dog groomed at Anna Simson Grooming Center. They did a beautiful job and exceeded my expectations. The price was very reasonable. I highly recommend bringing your pet here for grooming!

Anna is extraordinary!
She's incredibly sweet and incredibly talented, she's well-prepared and uses excellent products. ❤️
My Cheriè is a bit of a coward, and when I leave her with her, she's completely at peace.
Highly recommended.

Truly exceptional! I brought my 4-year-old giant schnauzer, who is not exactly easy to handle, and Anna, even though she had never seen him before, was excellent at taking care of him, not to mention that he came out beautiful!!!! We have already booked the next appointment.
Well done, there is nothing else to add, a small addition could be, that they know how to relate well to everyone, both the staff and the owners.

I'm writing this review to inform people that this groomer employs two incompetent people. Mrs. Anna doesn't deliver on her promises. A few days ago, I brought my dog ​​(a cocker spaniel) to be groomed, and instead of grooming her, she handed her over to someone who, in my opinion, should be selling mortadella at the supermarket. Eva (my dog) was unrecognizable and also scared and traumatized. When I brought her home, she wouldn't stop shaking, and it took me a long time to calm her down, so be wary of this groomer.
Very good and highly recommended!

Anna is excellent! She's so sweet with my Trudy and affectionate with me and my mom every time we go! I highly recommend her; you won't regret it!
I brought the dog and had a great time.
We brought our westy Nina, very competent, we recommend her!

I went there today for the first time, with my dog, and I was very happy with the result. These two professionals work magic. They know how to transform your dog, in a wonderful way. I'll be back again. I highly recommend them.
Courtesy and professionalism

We took our Schnauzer to Anna. Even though it was far from home, we needed a professional, and she did. The dog had several fur defects caused by other less-than-skilled groomers. The prices are moderately high; grooming is definitely expensive, but nail and ear trimming could be included in the final price to keep costs down.

Thanks, Anna
I brought my little Maltipoo dog, who had a really messy coat, and they delivered him back beautiful!! Highly recommended!!
